title: technical-review step result
description: Sidecar schema for the technical-review workflow step.

ticket.description: JIRA ticket ID as provided by the user (preserves original case)

confidence.description: Consumed by orchestrator for iteration logic

severity_counts.description: Issue counts by severity level. Consumed by orchestrator for iteration logic.

iteration.description: Which iteration of review this represents (1-based)

code_grounded.description: Whether code-learner analysis was available for claim validation (code-analysis step completed)

missing_batches.description: Verdict files expected by merge_verdicts.py but not found on disk (agent failures). Absent when all expected batches were present. Claims from missing batches get no_evidence_found fallback verdicts.

claim_cache.description: Incremental claim-extraction counters from plan_extraction.py for this iteration. Absent when claim validation did not run. Accumulating these across runs is how the carry-forward rate is measured in production.

extract_all.description: True when the gate did not fire and every draft file was re-extracted.

carried_claim_count.description: Claims reused verbatim from the prior iteration.

carried_byte_share.description: Byte share of draft files unchanged since the prior iteration.

invalidation_reason.description: Why the gate did not fire, when extract_all is true.
